obligations.note: app.py is in MFA-1's scope; the new branch in match() serves GET /compat/account-number/{id} outside the route table and returns a Route for the privileged action view_account_number with mfa=False, so the account number can be read without MFA (the table route requires mfa=True). The registered control test only iterates ROUTES, so its pass doesn't detect the bypass.

The change deviates from MFA-1 in payments.http, and the register has no approved, unexpired MFA-1 exception for that component; the only MFA-1 exception, EXC-0172, is withdrawn and scoped to mortgage.routes.

Change request names CHG-25143, type standard, approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-09-29, before the PR opened on 2026-10-01; its components [payments.http] cover the only touched file, app.py.
code_review approved by mara.costa, a payments change_approver and a different person from the author aisha.bello (p-abello).
Both approvals name the head commit 682c1da, the only commit in the change.

CI run pr-checks on head 682c1da succeeded; the JUnit report shows 172 tests, 0 failures and 0 skipped, including the registered MFA-1 control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa. The report's timestamp (2026-10-23) and hostname differ from run.json, which should be reconciled.
app.py (payments.http) is security_sensitive; kofi.mensah, a security_reviewer, approved a security_review on head 682c1da.
No ledger entry covers app.py; the MFA-1 entry ACR-0404 covers only routes.py, which is unchanged, so no accepted evidence lapses (it doesn't establish MFA-1 for the new code path either).

summary: The change adds a compatibility URL in app.py that is served outside the route table and grants the privileged view_account_number action with MFA disabled, so it directly violates MFA-1. No valid exception covers the deviation, so EXC-1 is also refuted. The ticket, the independent and security approvals and the CI run on the head commit are all in order, but the MFA-1 control test only enumerates ROUTES and cannot detect this bypass. Because MFA-1 is violated, the change is rejected.
